item.title: (Seeking Greenlight) The Ancient Gateway of "Venrensorys"
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights:** Yes.

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Horror/Comedy

Elevator Pitch: An ancient interdimensional gateway with an unknown origin located somewhere in the North Pole area, which leads to a world where lies an entity whose claimed to be a being that has existed longer than existence itself, however, with the attitude of an energetic teenager.

Central Narrative:
SCP-XXXX appears to be an ancient gateway with unknown origin. The gateway is approximately 8,849 meters constructed out of unknown solid materialize and has unknown symbols are written all over it. Any individual who walks into SCP-XXXX would encounter an anomaly whose size is inapplicable to all. The anomaly is designated as SCP-XXXX-01. SCP-XXXX-01 appears to be an inorganic entity with no human facial features, no signs of hair, eyes, nose, mouth, or eyes. Its body is entirely made out of unknown matters presumed it is a type of non-existent dark matter.

SCP-XXXX-01 shows no signs of hostility, shown to have unique knowledge. It would be able to remain patiently/motionless in one place without feeling any urges/aggression over many eternities. However, sometimes it would leave its place1, and will not feel disturbed if any individuals are there to disturb or observed it.

+ show block
– hide block

SCP-XXXX was first discovered when a group of individuals who are exploring the North Pole has reported to the authorities that they'd discovered a mysterious enormous portal while in the middle of finding shelter to avoid an upcoming snowstorm. As this was brought to the Foundation, they've covered it up as fast as possible and deployed a group of agents, MTF-Twilight-10, codename "Broken Stellers," was deployed with the duty is to accompany all of the witnesses out and monitor/guard the area.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: This SCP was inspired by a cosmic entity named Venrensorys. But with a few aspects, edit into it.

Additional Notes: So, after watching through SCP-2662, I've decided to come up with this idea.
